XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Gearbox returns to neutral after engaging gear.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: GEARBOX | ROBOTISED | NEUTRAL | GEAR | P1769 | ENTER | NEUTRAL |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Vehicles equipped with Selespeed gearbox

  • System: Gearbox

  • Device: Pressure accumulator

  • Fault: Unable to engage gears when starting the engine. Gearbox returns to neutral after engaging gear.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P1769: Pump control relay stuck

  • Cause: The fault may be due to an electronic power supply problem or a pressure accumulator that is not working

• Action: Check that the relay and its protective fuse for the robotised gearbox actuator pump in the engine compartment fuse box are working properly. If the problem persists, replace the pressure accumulator (shown in the figure).
